package com.banksorter;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;

//List of display categories
@Getter
@RequiredArgsConstructor
enum ItemCategory
{
	MELEE_WEAPON("Melee weapons"),
	RANGED_WEAPON("Ranged weapons"),
	MAGIC_WEAPON("Magic weapons"),
	MELEE_ARMOUR("Melee armour"),
	RANGED_ARMOUR("Ranged armour"),
	MAGIC_ARMOUR("Magic armour"),
	NECKLACE("Necklaces & amulets"),
	RING("Rings"),
	AMMUNITION("Ammunition"),
	RUNES("Runes"),
	TELEPORTS("Teleports"),
	POTIONS("Potions"),
	FOOD("Food"),

	// Per-skill categories
	MINING("Mining"),
	SMITHING("Smithing"),
	WOODCUTTING("Woodcutting"),
	FIREMAKING("Firemaking"),
	FISHING("Fishing"),
	COOKING("Cooking"),
	FARMING("Farming"),
	HERBLORE("Herblore"),
	CRAFTING("Crafting"),
	FLETCHING("Fletching"),
	HUNTER("Hunter"),
	CONSTRUCTION("Construction"),
	RUNECRAFT("Runecraft"),

	CURRENCY("Currency & tokens"),
	MISC("Miscellaneous");

	private final String displayName;
}
